items.title: Google Maps alum's Voyage Labs raises $12M to build AI travel agent
items.why: Early-stage AI travel agent to watch as a possible concierge or booking partner for premium card travel perks.
items.summary_ai: Voyage Labs, founded by a former Google Maps staffer, raised $12 million to build an AI travel agent.
